chapter: Hutto 1978-79: family, favorites and record lists
title: Meeting his first wife Evelyn
summary: He met Evelyn at a dance at the Alamac Hotel while playing with Specht; she was beautiful and lived to about 1964.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I don't know. We'll discuss how personal we want to make some of these things. And when did Evelyn...?
Evelyn, I met her at a dance at the Alamac Hotel.
So you met her in New York.
That's where we were playing with Paul Speck. And she was a gorgeous looking woman.
Was she in show business or not?
No. Everybody said she should be. But she was a gorgeous girl.
A number of the pictures you have, I guess I recognized. Her hair was up.
Well don't go to lunch and we can do this later. And how long did she last?
